issue.observation: Synthetic preparation exercise: the spare inventory count differed from the readiness packet.

aar.expected: Reconcile inventory against the readiness packet before the final review.
aar.observed: The count was checked only during the final exercise review.
aar.cause: The preparation checklist did not identify a reconciliation owner or earlier checkpoint.

action.description: Add an earlier inventory reconciliation checkpoint and named handoff owner.
action.success: The sample packet and inventory worksheet reconcile; any discrepancy has an owner before the final review.

correction.evidence: SYN-FIX-001: revised checklist and reconciled sample worksheet
correction.result: Synthetic desk review confirms the checkpoint, owner and discrepancy handoff are present.

training.objective: Reconcile an inventory worksheet with a readiness packet and report discrepancies.
training.task: Using supplied synthetic documents, compare counts, identify the discrepancy and route it to the named owner.
training.standard: Identify every seeded discrepancy and document the owner and next action using the proposed rubric.
training.change: Add the earlier reconciliation checkpoint, an explicit owner field and an independent learner attempt.

verification.evidence: SYN-CHECK-001: simulated rubric and corrected packet walkthrough

closure.rationale: The synthetic correction and current training revision have linked review evidence; no operational approval is implied.
